# Shristi Estate Commercial Real Estate Advisory

> Premier commercial real estate consultancy based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India, serving Noida, Greater Noida, Yamuna Expressway, and the wider Delhi NCR region.

## Overview
Shristi Estate specializes exclusively in corporate office leasing, institutional IT/business parks, warehousing facilities, industrial plants, retail shops, and commercial land plots. Founded by Sanjeet Kumar, the firm provides end-to-end tenant representation, landlord advisory, and investment consultation.

## Core Specializations
- **Corporate Office Spaces**: Plug-and-play furnished offices, bare-shell floors, and managed workspaces in Noida Sector 62, Sector 125, Sector 16/18, and Noida-Greater Noida Expressway.
- **IT & Business Parks**: Grade-A tech campuses with 100% DG backup, triple-height lobbies, multi-tier security, and captive amenities (Candor TechSpace, Advant Navis Business Park, Max Towers, Oxygen Business Park, Stellar IT Park).
- **Warehousing & Logistics**: High-clearance PEB sheds, grade docks, container trailer maneuverability in Sector 83, Ecotech-1, and Greater Noida.
- **Manufacturing & Industrial**: Approved industrial sheds and plots in Sector 63, 85, Phase-II with high sanctioned industrial power load.
- **Commercial Land & Retail**: High-street shops in Sector 18 and investment land plots.

## Key Corridors & Micro-Markets
- **Sector 62, Noida**: Premier institutional IT corridor with immediate Blue Line metro access.
- **Noida-Greater Noida Expressway**: Institutional MNC corridor featuring Grade-A campuses (Sectors 125, 126, 127, 132, 135, 142).
- **Sector 16 / Sector 18, Noida**: High-density Central Business District (CBD) and retail center.
- **Greater Noida & Yamuna Expressway**: Next-generation logistics and industrial expansion zone connected to Noida International Airport (Jewar).
